assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome.

Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to detect arrhythmic events and guide anticoagulation and rate-control management.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is medically necessary.
The service is coded with CPT 93229.
The patient has documented paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The patient has documented sick sinus syndrome.
The diagnosis code I49.5 is associated with the patient's condition.
The diagnosis code I48.0 is associated with the patient's condition.
The claim was denied based on reason code CO-197.
The required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date.
SilverBridge Advantage requires prior approval for this specific diagnostic procedure.
This decision does not preclude the possibility of future coverage if proper authorization is secured.
The patient has the right to appeal this determination.
Detailed instructions regarding the appeals process, including necessary documentation and submission deadlines, are available in the member handbook or by contacting Member Services.
